Good questions

Before you book.

Is the one-week assessment really free?

Yes — currently complimentary for eligible pet parents in selected serviceable locations. Our team confirms availability for your area when they call.

How many sessions are included?

Three professional at-home sessions, on alternate days across roughly one week.

Why alternate days, not every day?

The gap is the point. You practise between visits, and the trainer measures how well your dog retains and responds next time.

Will my dog be fully trained in a week?

No. The week is to understand your dog, begin foundations and map the right long-term plan. Full training depends on age, goals and learning response.

Do I have to buy a package afterwards?

No. The assessment stands on its own. Continuing with a paid Hometails program is entirely optional.
